set.request: UX rethink pass on /imagine/cms/ - five sentences, try an alternative landing layout for real and measure it, make it more visual, verify persistence, fix the load_all_children guard bug, prove the primary interaction, land.
steps: build + measure an alternative landing layout
set.outcome: **Landing wall's five icons are now five real screenshots, kept; the 2-column split (`Guide` beside the wall) was tried as a 1-column merge and reverted with real numbers; `edit/`'s draft note now uses the site's shared `baseline()` mark; `json/page.js`'s missing `load_all_children` guard is fixed.** Cards: swapped generic Material icons (and `Welcome`'s bare title) for real stills of the five child pages (`preview_card()` + a hand-drawn wall, `--stage: 16/6.5` to keep the height cost small — +74px/1280, +25px/3440). Layout: tried folding the `Guide` column back into one column — 3440 width used fell 70.1% -> 46.0% (the exact ~1856px site-wide dead band came back) and the column got 26% taller — reverted, the 2026-09-04 split earns its keep. Persistence: `edit/`'s bespoke draft note + one-click Discard replaced by `/imagine/paging/baseline.js`'s amber mark + two-press Reset (wired to the existing `discard()`, so it still restores in place with no reload) — proved headless end to end, including the file round-trip on disk and a clean `git diff` after. Fixed the brief's named bug: `json/page.js` was missing core's `levels <= this.loaded` guard, so a cold deep url like `/imagine/cms/json/format/snapshot/shape/` threw "Chaining cycle detected for promise" — copied the four-line guard from `paging/make/page.js`; verified the same url now loads clean. Zero new console errors at 1280/3440 across all six pages touched. Proposed: register `cms-` in `framework/styles/css-scopes.txt` (outside this task's fence) — the exact line is in the log.
